# @surfaces-ui/tokens

Theme contract, presets and CSS variable output for Surfaces UI.

The theme contract, eight presets, colour derivation tested for contrast, and the CSS variables (`--sf-*`) every component is styled with. No dependencies and no DOM.

## Install

```bash
npm install @surfaces-ui/tokens
```

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.

Every Surfaces UI package is released at the same version; install them all at that one version, since mixing releases is not supported.
